scope: Main three-seed Glaive held-out JSON exact match; not BFCL or xLAM

uncertainty.seed_t_ci95: Unclipped mean +/- t(0.975,df=2)*sample_sd/sqrt(3); only three training seeds with fixed data. Normal-seed assumption is weak.
uncertainty.case_bootstrap: 1000 resamples, RNG seed42, percentile indices25/975. Average the three model outcomes within each shared case, then resample cases. Conditional on fitted models; 6000 seed-case outcomes are not independent cases.
uncertainty.boundary: Seed and case intervals describe different uncertainties, not a joint seed/data interval. No baseline held-out delta is claimed.

limitations: Agent review found semantic near-duplicates across Glaive splits; high accuracy is not evidence of uncontaminated generalization.
Synthetic Glaive source is the authorized fallback, not xLAM reproduction.
Agent negative review found one clear mislabel and two uncertain cases among50, not human-gold validation.
Ablations and final error analysis remain incomplete; no training data or original scores changed.
